title: BNS Section 331 — Lurking House-Trespass or House-Breaking by Night
topic: House-breaking by night, forced shutter entry, night intrusion
punishment: Imprisonment up to 14 years and fine (aggravated if prepared for hurt/assault)
triable_by: Court of Session / Magistrate First Class
ingredients: House-trespass or house-breaking effected after sunset and before sunrise
Entry effected through passage made by offender, breaking lock, or entering through unaccustomed opening
Preparation made for causing hurt, assault, or wrongful restraint
text: Whoever commits lurking house-trespass by night, or house-breaking by night, having made preparation for causing hurt to any person, or for assaulting any person, or for wrongfully restraining any person, or for putting any person in fear of hurt or of assault or of wrongful restraint, shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to fourteen years, and shall also be liable to fine.
practice_note: Applicable to forced shutter breaches with crowbars or cutting equipment during night hours.
